description: Change a report: its name, its filters, the columns it shows, how it is sorted, how many records a page holds. Pass only what changes. `criterias` REPLACES all the report's filters. It does NOT change a report's grouping or totals: for that create the report you want with create_report, then remove this one with delete_report. Ids come from get_reports.

criterias.description: The report's filters, ALL of them: this list replaces the ones it has (an empty list removes every filter). Same shape as in create_report.

per_page.description: Number of records per page (max 100, default 20)

property_ids.description: The columns shown, ALL of them (field ids or names); an empty list shows every column

sort_by.description: Field id or name to sort the records by

name: update_report
